title: Before its first push a Driver reruns the fast gate and the rules' pre-push checks; Coder gets the spec's file edits
summary: Specified, no open question: before the first push the Driver reruns the fast gate at the rebased head plus the rules' pre-push checks (chantier: just check; just eval-dry-run for CLI src or evals/kit); the Coder's prompt carries the spec's file edits as a checklist marked in r<n>.md.
